verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for an error and performance monitoring product, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Raygun. The evidence describes only a hosted service at raygun.com and api.raygun.com. Open-source client providers (SDKs) are not the core product and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
